title: Apprenticeship, internship and employer listings
goal: Partner listing drafts, submission for review, filtering and public browsing of approved or explicitly illustrative entries.
acceptanceCriteria: New listings remain unpublished until a reviewer approves; application and source URLs must be HTTPS. Seed listings are marked illustrative, not live vacancies.
prototypeBoundaries: In-memory stores reset on process restart.
Demo actor headers are not authentication.
Do not claim live external integrations or real opportunities unless verified.
